title: One Volcano Sent a Shock Wave Around the Earth Four Times

scenes.text: One volcano sent a shock wave around the whole Earth four times.
In January 2022, the Hunga Tonga eruption blasted a plume about thirty-six miles into the sky.
Its pressure wave raced across the planet and circled the globe four times in six days.
Weather stations as far as Hong Kong recorded the pressure jumps.
People in Alaska, roughly six thousand miles away, heard the boom.
Only Krakatoa, in 1883, ever made a wave like it. Four laps around the planet, from one volcano.

description:
One volcano sent a pressure wave around the entire Earth four times.
The 2022 Hunga Tonga eruption lifted a plume about 36 miles high, and its boom was reported in Alaska.
Have you ever felt the ground shake from something far away?
first_comment: If you could watch one volcano erupt safely, which would it be?
